text_block_list.text:
My Senior year alongside Red Desire
has officially begun.
Waking up early in the morning, I head out to the grounds as a way of praying for good luck—

Ah... This crisp, pure air,
and the auspicious light raining down from the heavens...

To make a pledge for the new year,
to think such a fitting stage has been prepared—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: May this year be a wonderful one for all of us—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
May fortune favor our journey as we cross the sea
and face even greater trials ahead—...!

Red Desire offered her prayers—serenely,
yet soaringly high above all else.
I watched over her for a while...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, Trainer-san?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Did you come to offer
New Year's prayers as well?
choice_data_list: Well... I guess that's about it?

text_block_list.text:
I wanted to renew my vow here in this place,
so that I can run at full throttle together
with Red Desire for another whole year.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes... our hearts are truly as one.
This is a very auspicious start, indeed.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: This year, a challenge far across the seas... an overseas challenge awaits.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
It is certain to be an even steeper road than last year.
We must brace ourselves all the more firmly.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: The two of us, our hearts as one.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Fufu...—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—...!
I had forgotten something of utmost importance...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Once again,
Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year.
I am truly delighted to be able to welcome
the dawn of a new year with you.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Please look kindly upon me, Red Desire the Saint,
for this coming year as well.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Since we have this chance...
would you care to join me just like this?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Let us go and declare
this fresh vow before the altar.

Guided by Red Desire,
I arrived to make the first shrine visit of the New Year.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Trainer, this way.

Standing side-by-side with Red Desire,
we straighten our collars and face the shrine's worship hall.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(O Gods of this world.
I have come today to make a declaration.)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(—I promise you. This year, I will show you
a run that will shake the very laws of this world.
And then—...)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(This year, without fail, I shall reach it.
That distant "Parallel World"—)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(To the place where Saint Red Desire
can truly shine—!)

Feeling Red Desire praying fervently beside me,
I too made a heartfelt wish and a vow.
That vow was—
choice_data_list: Wishing for Desire to stay healthy
Wishing for Desire's overseas challenge to succeed
Wishing for Desire to be showered with praise

text_block_list.text:
This year will likely bring even tougher training and schedules than the last. But...
I want her to stay healthy every single day, both in mind and body.

"As her Trainer,
I vowed to watch over her from the closest vantage point."
To conquer harsh overseas races, she will need to push herself harder in training than ever before and build even greater strength.

"As her Trainer,
I vowed to support her no matter what happens."

Being recognized and receiving attention from people is a huge motivation for her.
I want to make sure she has plenty of opportunities to shine this year as well.

"As her Trainer,
I vowed to lend her all the support I could muster."
And so, having finished visiting the shrine, upon returning to the academy—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Cafe-san!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year,
Cafe-san.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I was hoping to come say hello, but...
Are you heading to training now?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: No, not me...—

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
"Cafe! I'm heading to the field first!
The Wakagoma Stakes
won't wait for us!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Some underclassmen asked me to coach them.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that so... Cafe was a great help to me last year as well.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Besides, training right from New Year's Day...
I cannot afford to rest either.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu. It seems all those girls...
were inspired by your running."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ? ...Mine?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Having seen your hard-fought battle last year...
they insisted that I, as your trainer, should see it.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
There is simply no end to the people
coming to me asking for guidance...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Oh, my...! Could such a thing really...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
How wonderful...!
For Cafe-san's marvelous insights to spread
is truly a blessing for this world.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
To have been able to contribute to that
is an absolute pleasure for me as well.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes. She is also very happy...
that it led to such a wonderful result.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: With her...? Could she be... Cafe's...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe, they're my "friends."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
She is... extremely satisfied
with the crimson passion radiating from you...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It seems they have high hopes that you
might be able to overcome the destiny
that may one day arrive...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Of course... myself as well.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Oh, my...! To think you hold me in such high regard...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I am deeply honored. I shall devote myself even further to live up to those expectations.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Please give my best regards
to your "friend" as well.

And so, I saw Manhattan Cafe off
as she headed to mentor her junior.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah... So many people are eagerly awaiting
my breakthrough...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Could you give me a trial befitting the start of a sacred new year?
Bathed in the sunlight of the new year, Red Desire overflowed with confidence and looked truly radiant.

"A new chapter of the Saint
begins right here—"
